en.image-obfuscator.title: Image Obfuscator
en.image-obfuscator.description: Obfuscate and restore images in your browser with a space-filling curve permutation. The password is optional. Nothing is uploaded.
en.image-obfuscator.keywords: image obfuscation, image encryption, image hiding, image protection.
en.image-obfuscator.subtitle: Space-filling curve permutation · Runs entirely in your browser
en.image-obfuscator.privacy_notice: All processing happens locally with Canvas and Web Crypto. Your images and password never leave this device.
en.image-obfuscator.upload_drop: Drop an image here or click to upload
en.image-obfuscator.upload_hint: PNG, JPG or WebP · up to 20MB · max 4096px per side
en.image-obfuscator.paste_hint: You can also paste with Ctrl+V
en.image-obfuscator.password_placeholder: Leave empty to work without a password
en.image-obfuscator.password_hint: Leave it empty to use the fixed offset, which anyone can restore. A password derives a private offset instead.
en.image-obfuscator.strength_hint: Higher values scatter pixels further, but survive JPEG compression less well.
en.image-obfuscator.strength_zero_hint: 0 means pass-through: the pixels stay untouched.
en.image-obfuscator.green_boost_desc: An extra reversible layer on the green channel. Lossless PNG only; keep it off for JPEG.
en.image-obfuscator.format_png_desc: Restores every pixel exactly when the settings match.
en.image-obfuscator.format_jpeg_desc: Smaller files, but compression noise makes an exact pixel restore impossible.
en.image-obfuscator.note_params: To restore, use the same password (if one was set), strength, dimensions and format settings.
en.image-obfuscator.note_security: This is a visual obfuscation tool, not encryption. Do not use it as a substitute for real encryption.
en.image-obfuscator.large_warning: This image is large; processing may take a while on mobile devices.
en.image-obfuscator.alpha_removed: Transparent areas were filled with white for JPEG output.
en.image-obfuscator.size_hint: Obfuscated PNG is {actual}, close to the raw pixel size ({raw}). PNG compression relies on neighbouring pixels being similar; shuffled pixels cannot be compressed. Switch the output format to JPG if you need a smaller file (lossy).
en.image-obfuscator.meta_detected_hint: The parameters below were filled in automatically. Input the password (if set) and click “Restore image”.
en.image-obfuscator.url_external: Only images hosted on this site are supported for now.
en.image-obfuscator.url_failed: The image from the URL could not be loaded.
en.image-obfuscator.error_decode: This image could not be decoded.
en.image-obfuscator.error_unsupported_type: Unsupported file type. Please use PNG, JPG or WebP.
en.image-obfuscator.error_unsupported_size: Images larger than 4096px per side or 16 megapixels are not supported.
en.image-obfuscator.error_insecure_context: Web Crypto is unavailable. Please open this page over HTTPS or localhost.
en.image-obfuscator.error_worker: The background worker failed. Please try again.
en.image-obfuscator.error_process: Something went wrong while processing the image.

cn.image-obfuscator.title: 图片混淆
cn.image-obfuscator.description: 在浏览器内用空间填充曲线置换来混淆与还原图片，密码可选，不上传任何数据。
cn.image-obfuscator.keywords: 图片混淆, 图片加密, 图片隐藏, 图片保护
cn.image-obfuscator.subtitle: 空间填充曲线置换 · 全程在浏览器本地完成
cn.image-obfuscator.privacy_notice: 所有处理都通过 Canvas 与 Web Crypto 在本地完成，图片和密码都不会离开这台设备。
cn.image-obfuscator.upload_drop: 拖拽图片到此处，或点击上传
cn.image-obfuscator.upload_hint: 支持 PNG、JPG、WebP · 单文件不超过 20MB · 单边不超过 4096px
cn.image-obfuscator.result_empty: 处理结果会显示在这里
cn.image-obfuscator.password_hint: 留空时使用固定偏移，任何人都能还原；填写密码则会派生私有偏移量。
cn.image-obfuscator.strength_hint: 强度越高像素打散得越彻底，但经 JPEG 压缩后还原效果会变差。
cn.image-obfuscator.strength_zero_hint: 0 表示直通：像素完全不变。
cn.image-obfuscator.green_boost_desc: 在绿色通道上叠加的可逆增强层，仅 PNG 无损场景可完全还原，JPG 建议关闭。
cn.image-obfuscator.format_png_desc: 参数一致时可逐像素完全还原。
cn.image-obfuscator.format_jpeg_desc: 文件更小，但压缩噪声导致无法逐像素还原。
cn.image-obfuscator.note_params: 还原需要相同的密码（若已设置）、强度、图片尺寸与格式参数。
cn.image-obfuscator.note_security: 这是视觉混淆工具，不是加密。请勿用它替代真正的加密方案。
cn.image-obfuscator.large_warning: 图片较大，移动端处理可能需要一些时间。
cn.image-obfuscator.alpha_removed: 输出 JPG 时，透明区域已用白色填充。
cn.image-obfuscator.size_hint: 混淆后的 PNG 为 {actual}，已接近原始像素体积（{raw}）。PNG 依赖相邻像素相似性压缩，打乱后基本无法再压缩；需要更小体积请把输出格式改为 JPG（有损）。
cn.image-obfuscator.meta_detected: 已从图片中读取到混淆参数
cn.image-obfuscator.meta_detected_hint: 参数已自动填入，输入密码（若已设置）后，点击「开始还原」即可。
cn.image-obfuscator.url_external: 暂不支持处理其他网站的图片。
cn.image-obfuscator.url_failed: 无法加载该链接中的图片。
cn.image-obfuscator.error_unsupported_type: 不支持的文件类型，请使用 PNG、JPG 或 WebP。
cn.image-obfuscator.error_unsupported_size: 不支持单边超过 4096px 或总像素超过 1600 万的图片。
cn.image-obfuscator.error_insecure_context: 当前环境无法使用 Web Crypto，请通过 HTTPS 或 localhost 打开本页面。
cn.image-obfuscator.error_worker: 后台 Worker 执行失败，请重试。
